wire.headline: Utility Firm Reports Mixed Results Amid Job Cuts and Billing Probe
sentences: Revenue increased by 7% year over year to reach 4.26bn GBP for the quarter ending 30 September.
Pre-tax profit decreased by 12% to 310m GBP.
The company announced plans to cut 850 jobs, which represents about 6% of its workforce.
Two gas plants are scheduled to close by March 2027.
CEO Marian Holt stated that cost pressure has been sharper than expected.
Ofgem has opened an investigation into the company's billing system.
The dividend has been held steady at 12.4p a share.
Shares fell by 4.2% during morning trading.
